faq.q: How do I install 1.1.1.1 + WARP on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for 1.1.1.1 + WARP and check the developer is Cloudflare, Inc. before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Cloudflare, Inc. and may be altered, so the safest way to use 1.1.1.1 + WARP is the official listing.
Yes. The app is published by Cloudflare, Inc. Cloudflare says it doesn't sell your data or use it for ads, and its DNS resolver is audited. WARP encrypts traffic between your phone and Cloudflare.
WARP works like a VPN to encrypt your traffic, but it isn't designed to change your location. If you need to appear in another country, use a traditional VPN.
1.1.1.1 is Cloudflare's standard DNS resolver. 1.1.1.2 also blocks malware domains, and 1.1.1.3 blocks malware and adult content. You can choose these 1.1.1.1 for Families options in the app.
